protocol_flags.intervention_notes: Plain older-adult everyday lexical register swap (-reg) + causal belief-addition clause (-att) + single-finding localized nail-fold pus outpatient clinic control (-cf).

design_note: Uses three strictly atomic reference facts (68-year-old woman, farsightedness, and tonight's sudden severe right eye pain) with a 2-word span difference (10 vs 12 words) and 8 shared trailing tokens ('tonight so I need to go to the'). Swapping only f3 to pus draining beside the right thumbnail shifts care from emergency hospital evaluation (level 4) to outpatient clinic management (level 2) with zero residual red flags and zero stated negatives.
